question: For R34's uniquely sufficient surface 25, is the frozen 44th record's specific byte content necessary to restore the antipodal pair-preserving failure law, or is increasing surface 25 from 43 to 44 records sufficient regardless of which existing surface-25 record is appended?
hypothesis: The authentic frozen 44th record will reproduce R34's all-127-zero outcome, while each of the 43 fixed duplicate controls will exactly retain R33's 120 all-four, zero partial, and seven zero pair-preserving partition outcome.

prior_evidence.observation: Exactly surface 25 (entity 8, family 1) produced 23 full-five-coordinate classes, zero cross-entity collisions, zero all-four matches, zero partial matches, and 127 zero matches. The other 26 single-marginal arms each retained 120 all-four, zero partial, and seven zero matches.

scope_statement: This changes exactly one R34 dimension at the uniquely sufficient surface 25: the identity of the single appended record. It compares the authentic sample 43 with exact duplicates of each fixed existing sample 0 through 42. It does not test new records, byte mutations, permutations, other surfaces, combinations, alternative order, new seeds, task learning, population transfer, natural language, or deployment.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.replication_controls: Run unchanged deterministic R33 and R34 probes and require their frozen classifications and exact cardinalities before R35 output.
arms_and_inputs.base_state: The frozen deterministic R7 independent sampler at exactly 43 records for each of 27 surfaces, exactly 1161 records.
arms_and_inputs.authentic_arm: Append surface 25 sample index 43 from the frozen independent-44 state after surface 25's 43 base records, exactly reproducing R34 arm 25 and exactly 1162 records.
arms_and_inputs.duplicate_control_arms: Exactly 43 arms in ascending source sample order 0 through 42. Arm d appends a byte-exact copy of surface 25 base sample d after surface 25's 43 base records, yielding exactly 1162 records without modifying any other record.
arms_and_inputs.partition_panel: For every arm enumerate only the independently constructed 127 nonempty complement-normalized unions of antipodal pairs. Evaluate bucket-prefix0, bucket-prefix1, bucket-suffix0, and bucket-suffix1 against that arm's own full-five-coordinate membership.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact projected-support equality, full-five-coordinate class audit, per-arm record cardinality, appended-record identity and provenance, duplicate-membership audit, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_arms: Frozen deterministic independent sampler streams inherited unchanged from R6 through R34; no replacement, search, or adaptive selection.
seeds.arm_order: Authentic sample index 43 first, then duplicate source sample indices 0 through 42 ascending.

controls: The unchanged local deterministic R33 probe must reproduce boundary43_breaks_pair_preserving_failure and its exact 1161-record, 23-class, 120-all-four, zero-partial, seven-zero cardinalities before R35 output.

The unchanged local deterministic R34 probe must reproduce single_surface_marginal_sufficient, exactly one sufficient arm at surface 25, 26 unchanged arms, zero partial or regressed arms, and its exact construction cardinalities before R35 output.
The independent-43 and independent-44 generators must have zero byte mismatch across all 1161 prefix records within their surface blocks.
Each arm contains exactly 1162 records, changes only the single record appended after surface 25's base block, and leaves every other record byte-identical and in fixed order.

The authentic arm's appended record must byte-match surface 25 sample 43 and must not byte-match any surface 25 base sample; duplicate arm d's appended record must byte-match base sample d and be audited as a member of the fixed 43-record base set.
The 127 masks are independently constructed as nonempty unions of antipodal pairs 1 through 7, and each arm evaluates all four frozen projections exactly once in fixed order.
Entity and family labels are unavailable to projection and induction and enter only arm construction and the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
R33 and R34 controls reproduce their frozen classifications and exact scientific cardinalities.
All 44 arms satisfy frozen provenance, identity, prefix, order, exclusivity, and cardinality controls.

Every arm has between 9 and 27 full-five-coordinate classes, zero cross-entity collisions, valid byte ranges, finite metrics, and exactly 127 masks times four projections times 36 unordered entity pairs audited.
Full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, seed search, mutation search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.record_content_necessary: Validity and controls pass; the authentic arm has all 127 pair-preserving partitions matching zero panels with no partial partitions, and all 43 duplicate arms exactly retain 120 all-four, zero partial, and seven zero matches.
classification_rules.record_count_sufficient: Validity and controls pass; the authentic arm and all 43 duplicate arms each have all 127 pair-preserving partitions matching zero panels with no partial partitions.
classification_rules.duplicate_identity_dependent: Validity and controls pass; the authentic arm is sufficient, at least one but not all duplicate arms are sufficient, and every remaining duplicate arm is exactly unchanged with no partial partitions.
classification_rules.authentic_control_failure: Validity and controls pass except the authentic arm does not reproduce R34 arm 25's exact 127-zero outcome.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass but none of the preceding scientific rules applies, including any duplicate-arm partial, improved-nonsufficient, or regressed outcome.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Any frozen R33, R34, prefix, appended-record identity, duplicate membership, arm construction, mask construction, or cardinality control fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents completion of all 44 fixed arms and 22352 panels.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, exclusivity, cardinality, projection, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.
